desc:
🫧 Make your dream slime in Slime Studio!

Mix, stretch, squish and create endless unique slimes in this satisfying ASMR sandbox! 🌈

🧪 Experiment with colours, textures and ingredients!

🎁 Unlock new tools and ingredients as you play!

✨ Discover special items in the shop!

🎧 Turn up your volume for satisfying ASMR sounds!

💖 Like the game and join the group for more updates and a free reward!
